fields.statement: At 376a05b23, go test -count=1 -trimpath ./internal/release/... ./tools/release/... passes (vet and gofmt clean). TestBuild builds a manifest from a dist folder with the four rhiza_<ver>_<os>_<arch>.tar.gz archives and checksums.txt and checks channel=release, version=tag, commit, 4 platforms, each sha256 equal to checksums.txt and the releases/download/<tag>/<archive> URL; TestBuildMissingPlatform and TestBuildChecksumMismatch fail as required. Ran the release-snapshot job's new step by hand on a fake GoReleaser-shaped dist (metadata.json version 0.0.1-SNAPSHOT-376a05b): it wrote dist/manifest.json with 4 platforms and the jq length check passed; with darwin_arm64 removed, go run ./tools/release exited 1 with 'missing platforms: darwin/arm64', so the job fails. release.yml runs the tool after goreleaser on v* tags and uploads manifest.json as a release asset (--clobber), so releases/latest/download/manifest.json names the newest release. Diff read: archive names match .goreleaser.yaml name_template. GoReleaser itself not run (not installed; CI runs it).
